title: Nvidia Investigates CEO Jensen Huang Over Spy Reports
excerpt: Nvidia's board is launching an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's reported ties to a Chinese intelligence recruit.
body_html:
Nvidia's board of directors announced an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang. The inquiry focuses on his relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang.

According to reports, Alice Huang was recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to gather intelligence on the chipmaking company. Nvidia's board confirmed the move following these developments.
